delivered: Windows x64 Screen Target NDI publishes picture and named virtual audio with physical playback disabled. NDI is available from the normal Media and Screen controls at first launch.

checks.runtime: Fresh app profile in a private bundle layout with NDI_RUNTIME_DIR_V6 removed. The fixture attempted to redirect ProgramFiles, but a later child-process check showed Windows restored the system path.
checks.picture: Independent SDK receiver sampled red then green at 320x240/30 after closing the editor panels, and green at 240x160/24 on a custom sender. Disable and delete withdrew their senders.
checks.audio: At 48 kHz, channel 1 carried the 880 Hz Right virtual bus signal and channel 3 carried the 440 Hz Left bus signal. Channel 2 was unassigned with zero RMS across 89 sampled audio blocks. Physical output was disabled.
checks.timestamps: Nearest observed picture timecodes were 46.3151 ms and 9.4264 ms from the two sampled audio blocks. This measured timestamp proximity on one machine.
checks.software: 117 Screen tests, two NDI Media tests, Golden Audio tap and managed-render regression, strict Rust clippy, Svelte check, Prettier and the Windows build passed.
